name: Samurai Battle Strike
purpose: Display during critical strikes and active boss battles.
visual: Dynamic mid-air leaping slash forming dramatic cross-silhouette.
prompt: A minimalist 2D graphic illustration for a premium video game, inspired by bold cinematic silhouette poster art. A samurai warrior leaping dynamically in mid-strike with dual swords forming an iconic cross silhouette, near-black silhouette with crimson edge highlights. Giant solid crimson-red moon backdrop, flat pitch-black canvas, sharp vector lines, no anime, no 3D, no text.
